links.outcome: Gender and skin-tone representation of medical imaging professionals in DALL-E 3 generated images
links.effect: 57.4% of characters were male, 42.4% female, and 91.2% light skin tone. Men were overrepresented in all professions except nursing (26% male). No persons with a disability were depicted.
links.quote: Generated images have a disproportionately high representation of white men, which is not representative of the diversity of the medical imaging professions.

screen.reason: Empirical study evaluating demographic bias (gender and skin tone representation) in DALL-E 3 generated images of medical imaging professionals.
